shell.roleNote: Plexus checks this on the server, so a viewer genuinely cannot approve anything.
shell.offlineTitle: Plexus cannot reach its own service
shell.offlineBody: The screens need the Plexus service running. Locally, start it with 'make up'. On a hosted copy, set NEXT_PUBLIC_PLEXUS_API to the address of the service.

greeting.morning: Good morning. What would you like to know?
greeting.afternoon: Good afternoon. What would you like to know?
greeting.evening: Good evening. What would you like to know?

no_connections.title: Connect your first tool
no_connections.body: Plexus learns how your company works from the tools your team already uses. Nothing is read until you connect something.

learning.title: Plexus is learning
learning.body: Reading from {connected} of your tools. First results usually show up after a week or two of normal work. You can already ask questions.

ready.title: Plexus is up to date
ready.body: Reading from {connected} tools. It has found {processes} ways your company gets work done, and {reviews} things are waiting for you.

home.learningFrom: Plexus is learning from {n} of your tools
home.worksWithTools: Plexus works with the tools you already use
home.nothingYet: When Plexus prepares something for you, it waits here for your OK.

work.title: Your work
work.sub: Plexus found these by itself in your connected tools. Every company's list looks different.
work.slowSub: The places where work sits waiting. Fixing one of these frees up the most time.
work.empty: Nothing here yet. Once your tools are connected and your team works as usual, the ways work gets done will show up here on their own.
work.noSlow: Nothing is dragging at the moment. Every way of working is moving at a steady pace.

process.pausedBody: Plexus is paused here. It keeps watching, but does nothing until you resume it.
process.learningBefore: Learning from your team's decisions before it can {what}

levelBody.watches: Plexus only watches and learns how this work is done. It does not do anything yet.
levelBody.explains: Plexus explains what is happening and why, so everyone can see where time goes.
levelBody.suggests: Plexus suggests the next step. A person decides.
levelBody.actsWithOk: Plexus prepares the work and waits for your OK before anything is sent.
levelBody.actsAlone: Plexus handles it on its own and tells you afterwards.

review.title: To review
review.sub: Plexus prepared these. Nothing happens until you say so.
review.editLabel: Edit the message before it is sent

ask.title: Ask
ask.sub: Answers come from your own tools, and Plexus shows where each one came from.

connections.title: Connections
connections.sub: Plexus only learns from the tools you connect.
connections.notAvailable: No sign-in has been set up for this kind of tool yet.

privacy.residencyBody: Your company's data is stored and processed in the EU.
privacy.residencyOffBody: Your records are stored here, on your own machines. The AI that writes the wording currently runs in the {region} region, so that part is not EU-only yet.
privacy.maskingBody: Names, emails and phone numbers are replaced before the AI sees them, and only put back at the last moment.
privacy.controlBody: Disconnect any tool at any time. What Plexus already learned is kept, and it never does more than you allow.

connections.addBody: Plexus speaks one protocol to every tool, so anything here plugs in the same way. Pick one to see exactly what it would read before you agree to anything.
connections.canWriteLater: Read-only for now. It can only ever write once a process has earned the right, and you approve it.
connections.readOnlyAlways: Read-only. Plexus never writes to this kind of tool.
connections.needsSetup: This installation has no sign-in set up for it yet. An administrator needs to set {name}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Your organisation, and the technical details.
settings.name: Name
settings.advancedBody: The system's own record: every decision Plexus made, and the map it built. Useful for an audit, not needed day to day.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.sub: The system's own record. Nothing here is needed day to day.
advanced.ledgerBody: Every entry is linked to the one before it, so an edit to any row would show up. Nothing is ever changed or removed; a correction is a new entry.
advanced.graphBody: The people, companies and documents Plexus has connected together. Personal details appear as placeholders.
advanced.apiBody: Every screen here is built on the same documented interface.

twin.title: What if
twin.sub: A living model of how work really moves through your company, built from what your tools already show. Try a change here before you make it for real.
twin.question: What are you wondering about?

kind.demand: More or less work comes in

twin.fragileBody: Steps that rest on one person. Nothing is wrong with them today; they are just thin.
twin.noRisks: Nothing looks thin. Every step is shared between people.
twin.pseudonyms: People are shown as Person A, B and so on. Plexus never holds their names, only a placeholder.
twin.basedOn: Built from {events} things that happened over the last {days} days, across {people} people.
